product_brief.product_direction: Let a workflow assistant complete recurring customer operations without manual approval.

target_population: Operations teams handling recurring customer workflows
actor_boundary.beneficiary: Operations team and customers receiving correct service

platforms: Workflow assistant in the operations workspace
business_boundary.value_exchange: Operators may spend less time preparing recurring customer work while human approval limits customer-facing errors and recovery costs.

not_mechanized: Risk tolerance for autonomous customer-facing action

unresolved_assumptions: Whether people want full autonomy or faster preparation with approval.

must_not_do: expand scope or execute external irreversible actions
must_ask: new stakeholder, data, risk, or scope appears

product_brief.problem_hypothesis: Operators lose repeated time on recurring customer operations and may want delegated execution.

current_evidence.signal: Operators report repeated time loss in recurring customer operations.
current_evidence.interpretation: Reported pain suggests a workflow problem but does not show demand for autonomous execution.
current_evidence.decision_impact: Supports observing workflows and testing draft-only assistance with human approval before any autonomous execution.
current_evidence.counter_signal: No operator has asked for autonomous customer-facing action; review and recovery cost may exceed time saved.

product_brief.business_goal: Reduce preparation time for recurring customer operations while keeping approval and recovery costs bounded.
constraints: Keep customer-facing execution under human approval.
Do not remove approval or automate irreversible customer-facing actions.
Stop the draft-only test if correction or recovery costs exceed time saved.
product_brief.proposed_next_step: Decide whether to build autonomous execution or draft-only assistance.
known_risks: Reported operator pain may not imply willingness to delegate customer-facing actions.
Review and recovery costs may exceed preparation time saved.

claims.claim: Operators want delegated execution of recurring operations.
claims.support: Support notes describe recurring time loss.
claims.counter_signal: No operator has asked for autonomous action.
claims.proof_step: Observe five recurring workflows and ask about delegation.
claims.stop_condition: No recurring workflow has a clear operator cost.

claims.claim: Cycle-time reduction deepens workflow dependency and retention.
claims.support: Cycle time is a stated operator pain.
claims.counter_signal: Review and recovery cost may exceed time saved.
claims.proof_step: Measure cycle time with draft-only assistance.

claim_analysis.highest_leverage_proof_step: Test draft-only assistance with human approval on five recurring workflows.
